coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Bayfront Park
record.summary: A roughly 5.5-acre waterfront park at 16th Street and Terry A. Francois Boulevard, directly across from Chase Center, built by the Mission Bay Development Group for the Port of San Francisco with open lawns, a stretch of the Bay Trail, multiple plazas, and benches and sculptures made from reclaimed Bay Bridge steel; it had its public grand-opening celebration on October 22, 2024.

notes.accuracy_caveat: HIGH CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon, independently confirmed via its Port of San Francisco operator tag and Wikidata id. Opened Oct 22, 2024 (5.4 acres at 16th St and Terry A. Francois Blvd, opposite Chase Center); occupies the plan's former P21/P22 open-space parcels (Mission Bay South Design Controls Plan Boundary/Block Map).

open_questions: Reported size varies across sources (roughly 5.4 to 6 acres depending on the outlet); not resolved to one figure here.
October 22, 2024 is the public grand-opening celebration date; a separate physical-construction-completion date (permit final, certificate of occupancy) was not found in any source checked.

The groundbreaking article (SF YIMBY, Aug 10, 2022) says the ceremony was 'held last week,' so early August 2022 is used rather than a specific day; the article's own stated completion target (fall 2023) was superseded by the actual October 2024 opening, which is not itself explained in any source checked.

This record's own geometry file (data/manual/mission_bay_bayfront_park.geojson) notes the park occupies the Mission Bay South Design Controls Plan's former P21/P22 open-space parcels; OCII's own September 2023 open-space transition presentation (sfocii.org, Item 2) lists P21 as already Port-managed by that date but P22 as still 'when built' -- consistent with part of the site predating this park's 2024 completion, but not independently broken out here.
